hypothesis: The causal near-ATM implied-vol level of the OTHER underlying (cross-asset atm_iv spillover) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward realized return skewness (third standardized moment) of the target underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + alignment floor.
extends: EVAL-71/87/109 (same atm_iv signal path and sealed EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-77 (cross-asset alignment via build_cross_section) + EVAL-85 (forward-window convention lr[k:k+h]); distinct cell: cross-asset atm_iv spillover -> forward realized return skewness

protocol.title: Cross-asset near-ATM implied-vol spillover (other asset's atm_iv) -> forward own-asset realized return skewness predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-71/87/109 (same atm_iv signal path and sealed EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-77 (cross-asset alignment via build_cross_section) + EVAL-85 (forward-window convention lr[k:k+h]); distinct cell: cross-asset atm_iv spillover -> forward realized return skewness
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-71/87/95/101/109/111/112/113; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied-vol level of the OTHER underlying (e71.build_surface_bars atm_iv), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid (build_cross_section), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return skewness = m3 / m2**1.5 over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); third standardized moment, transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-109/111/112/113
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_atm_iv_z_k, own_skew_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset near-ATM IV -> more right-skewed forward returns on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades with iv/strike/expiry + perp candles); no new acquisition, no network

floor.note: Reuses the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor verbatim (min_option_trades_per_underlying=1000, min_near_atm_option_trades_per_underlying=400, min_perp_candles_per_underlying=1000, min_perp_span_seconds_per_underlying=82000s), applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, plus a cross-asset alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal near-ATM IV on the coarsest grid). Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
